tierReasoning: Confirmed Codex 429 exit classification and reporting are reversible with a code revert; no schema, credential, or new kill authority is introduced.

guardEvidence.howCaught: The registry model drives the confirmed dead Codex session for N and 2N monitor ticks and across restart; the persisted running-to-failed transition permits one alert per session and prevents repeated emissions.

causalAutopsy.notes: The session monitor treated every self-exit as completed, and live-prompt rate-limit detection could not observe a Codex process that exited on HTTP 429. Retained tmux panes then obscured the failed work in tmux-based counts.
